scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @wanyiyi/shared && npm run build -w @wanyiyi/domain
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @wanyiyi/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @wanyiyi/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @wanyiyi/api && npm run build -w @wanyiyi/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
